data.gender_notes: Costanza is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'costus', meaning 'costly, precious'. In Christian tradition, the name Costanza has been associated with the concept of constancy and strength, as seen in the story of St. Costanza, who remained faithful to her Christian beliefs despite facing persecution and martyrdom. The name Costanza carries the meaning “Costly, precious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Costanza usually hope their child will grow to embody costly, precious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolic of remaining steadfast in one's faith and beliefs.
data.etymology: Costanza belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Costly, precious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Costanza total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: קוסטנזה
in_hebrew.meaning: עובדה אמיתית, כבוד, זכות וכבוד (Constance - Truth, Honesty, Virtue)
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם 'קוסטנזה' נובע מהמילה הלטינית 'constantia' שמשמעה עובדה אמיתית, כבוד וזכות. בקרב הנוצרים, קוסטנצה היא גם שם של קדושה הקשורה לערכי צדק ואמת. השם נודע בעקבות האגדה על קונסטנס, הקיסרית הרומאית שהגן על הנצרות. במסורת הנוצרית, השם 'קוסטנזה' מסמל אמיתות, צדק וכבוד, ונחשב אחד השמות הטובים ביותר לילדים, כאשר נועדו הורים לקדש את ילדם.

in_greek.name: Κοστάνζα
in_greek.meaning: Αλήθεια, σεμνότης, αξία και σεμνότης (Constance - Truth, Honesty, Virtue)
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όνομα 'Κοστάνζα' προέρχεται από τη λατινική λέξη 'constantia' που σημαίνει αλήθεια, σεμνότης και αξία. Στην Ορθοδοξη Εκκλησία, η Κοστάνζα είναι και το όνομα της Αγίας που σχετίζεται με τα αρχαία αρετή και αλήθεια. Το όνομα γνώρισε ευρεία χρήση έπειτα από την ιστορία της Κωνσταντίας, της Ρωμαίας Αυτοκράτειρας που διατήρησε την πίστη της στην Ορθοδοξία. Στη Βυζαντινή παράδοση, το όνομα 'Κοστάνζα' συμβολίζει την αλήθεια, την αρετή και την σεμνότητα, και θεωρείται ως ένα από τα καλύτερα ονόματα για τα παιδιά, επειδή έτσι τα γονείς επιθυμούν να στεγάσουν την παιδιά τους.

in_latin.name: Costanza
in_latin.meaning: Veritas, honestas, virtus et honestas (Constance - Truth, Honesty, Virtue)
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen 'Costanza' originatur a vocabulo latino 'constantia' significante veritas, honestas, et virtus. In Ecclesia Christiana, Costanza est etiam nomen sancti qui conexus est cum virtutibus antiquis et veritate. Nomen cognitum est post historiam Constantiae, Imperatricis Romanorum qui servavit fidelem se in Ecclesia Christiana. In traditione Christiana, nomen 'Costanza' symbolizat veritatem, virtutem, et honestatem, et reputatur eximius nomen pro puellis, quia ita parents volunt ut pueri suos honorificent.

in_english.name: Costanza
in_english.meaning: Constance - A steadfast and honest person, strong in faith and virtue
in_english.long_meaning: The name Costanza originates from the Latin word 'constantia' meaning truth, honesty, and virtue. In Christian tradition, Costanza is also the name of a saint associated with ancient virtues and truth. The name gained popularity after the story of Constantia, the Roman empress who maintained her faith in the Christian church. In Christian tradition, the name 'Costanza' symbolizes truth, virtue, and honesty, and is considered one of the best names for children, as parents wish to honor their children with these qualities.

data.cultural_impact: The name Costanza, with its Latin roots and strong meaning, carries an air of nobility and resilience. Its association with the concept of costliness or preciousness adds a layer of value and elegance to the name.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Costanza represents a steadfast and unyielding commitment to one's beliefs, even in the face of adversity. It serves as a reminder of the importance of remaining true to one's faith, and the strength and courage that can be gained from doing so. The name's connection to St. Costanza, who was known for her unwavering faith and martyrdom, adds an additional level of inspiration and spiritual depth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Costanza, meaning "constancy" or "perseverance" in Italian, symbolizes the unwavering faith and steadfastness of a Christian in the face of trials and adversities. It is a reminder to stay devoted to one's beliefs and to keep moving forward despite challenges, drawing strength from the grace of God.
